en.cmd.save_desc: Encrypt this decrypted buffer and write it back to its SOPS file
en.cmd.reload_desc: Discard unsaved changes and decrypt the file again
en.cmd.decrypt_desc: Open the current SOPS-encrypted file decrypted, in memory only
en.cmd.toggle_desc: Switch between the decrypted buffer and the encrypted file
en.cmd.encrypt_file_desc: Encrypt the current plaintext file in place by the .sops.yaml creation rules
en.cmd.new_file_desc: Create a SOPS-encrypted file whose plaintext stays in memory
en.statusbar.title: SOPS
en.status.decrypted: SOPS: %{file} decrypted in memory. Ctrl+S encrypts and saves; Save As would write plaintext
en.status.unchanged: SOPS: no changes to save in %{file}
en.status.restricted: SOPS: %{file} is encrypted. The workspace is not trusted, so it was not decrypted automatically: run "SOPS: Decrypt Current File"
en.status.remote: SOPS: remote sessions are not supported
en.status.not_sops: SOPS: %{file} is not a SOPS-encrypted file
en.status.not_sops_buffer: SOPS: this is not a decrypted SOPS buffer
en.status.no_file: SOPS: this buffer is not a file
en.status.changed_on_disk: SOPS: %{file} changed on disk; saving will ask before overwriting it
en.status.auto_paused: SOPS: auto-save of %{file} skipped: the file changed on disk. Save with Ctrl+S to resolve
en.status.not_saved_yet: SOPS: %{file} has not been saved yet
en.status.binary_content: SOPS: %{file} holds binary data that cannot be edited as text
en.status.no_longer_encrypted: SOPS: %{file} on disk is no longer SOPS-encrypted
en.error.missing_binary: SOPS: cannot run "%{bin}": install sops or set plugins.sops.settings.binPath
en.error.mac: SOPS: MAC mismatch in %{file}. Enable ignoreMac to open it anyway
en.error.invalid: SOPS: %{file} was not saved, the content is invalid: %{detail}
en.error.no_config: SOPS: no .sops.yaml with creation rules found for %{file}
en.error.timeout: SOPS: sops did not finish on %{file} in time and was stopped
en.error.temp: SOPS: cannot create a private temporary directory
en.popup.conflict_msg: %{file} changed on disk after it was decrypted. Overwrite it with your version, or discard your changes and reload it?
en.popup.missing_msg: %{file} no longer exists. Create it again by the .sops.yaml creation rules?
en.popup.saveas_msg: The decrypted content of %{src} was written to %{dest} as plaintext. Encrypt that file in place by the .sops.yaml creation rules?
